name: Lightkeeper Questline Patch
teaser: No timegating or prerequisites to start Lightkeeper questline
description_html:
Modifies the Lightkeeper questline:

- Removes pre-requisite quests i.e unlocks the start of the questline Network Provider - Part 1 at level 25 from Mechanic

- Removes time-gating on quests

Copy the extracted user folder to your SPTarkov installation

Configuration is in user/mods/Oxide-LightkeeperQuestlinePatch/src/config.json.

skipTimeGate: setting true skips time gating for Mechanic & Lightkeeper quests

removeRequirements: setting true skips requirements to start the questline (https://tarkov.help/en/quest/lightkeeper-unlocking for 3.8.3)

Haven’t tested yet, might be incompatible with any quest overhaul or mods that change Lightkeeper quests. This mod changes the per-requisites for Network Provider - Part 1 and the startAfter time for all the quests in that chain after that point.

Delete the Oxide-LightkeeperQuestlinePatch folder. Shouldn’t change anything for accepted quest(s) but will change the rest of the questline back to normal
